elements.name: columns
elements.description: Places <column> elements side by side, and stacks them when the terminal is narrow.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Blank columns between the columns.

attributes.name: stack-below
attributes.description: Stacks the columns when the terminal is narrower than this many columns.

elements.name: column
elements.description: One column of <columns>; 'width' sets its share.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: The column's width: auto, a number of columns, a percentage or * for the rest.
attributes.accepts: 'auto', a column count such as '40', a percentage such as '50%', or '*' for the remaining width
